requests.prompt:
Create exactly ONE uninterrupted full-frame vertical 9:16 production illustration in detailed cinematic ChronoStick. Input image 1 is master rendering authority only; never copy its board layout. All surfaces are drawn with dark controlled outlines and simplified matte forms, muted ochre/umber/slate/burgundy/olive palette and soft cinematic illustrated shading. People have round off-white heads, dot eyes, very sparse brows/mouth, no realistic nose, narrow stick-derived bodies/limbs and simple pale drawn hands; detailed clothing follows that simplified skeleton, not human anatomical bodies. Standard full body about 5.0–5.8 head diameters, shoulders narrower than a head. No photorealistic inserts or painterly surface rendering. One scene, one viewpoint, one instant; exact inventory stated below. No grid, panels, border, repeated views, inset faces, typography, captions, labels, readable letters or numerals. All story-critical subjects/props within safe margins. Zero unlisted people, animals, vehicles, signs, flags, weapons or props.

Input image 2 controls the central modern masked adult and the identical ivory/black/rose mask motif for all three roles. Exactly THREE adult stick people in a sparse contemporary public-space scene, one view/instant, all calm and closed-mouth behind props. Central role closest to camera at screen center, full figure 60 percent frame height, charcoal hoodie/hood and blue-gray trousers exactly as supplied. Left supporting anonymous role one step behind at screen left, muted slate-blue hoodie/hood and charcoal trousers, figure 46 percent height. Right supporting anonymous role one step behind at screen right, muted burgundy hoodie/hood and dark trousers, same 46 percent height. Every figure has ONE worn mask with the same clean drawn motifs; simplified pale hands rest beside narrow stick-derived bodies, no raised fists, weapons, signs or readable text. All three complete heads, hands and shoes sit at least 8 percent of canvas width inside both side edges and 8 percent of canvas height above the bottom; generous empty paving below their feet. Heads/hoods and feet entirely safe; three distinct silhouettes separated with no overlap/duplication. Background is an explicitly PRESENT-DAY unnamed plaza: only two low, plain, rectilinear modern building blocks with flat roofs and a few empty unlettered rectangular windows, and empty drawn paving. These blocks stay small in the upper background, behind the trio. No historic streetscape, cathedral, castle, palace, domes, spires, clock towers, medieval arches, gas lamps, extra crowd or vehicles. The master style controls drawn rendering, never historical background content. Soft warm upper-left key and cool slate right fill. The central masked face is large enough for a resolved close crop; group scale tells spread of the symbol, not a named real protest event. No explosions or false historical Fawkes mask wearer.
